messages:
Amanda C: quick heads-up — I want to push a config-only change for tenant-specific guardrails during the late window (17:00-17:30 PT). low-risk but this tenant had tail spikes earlier. change summary: concurrency cap 20 -> 8, request timeout 12s -> 8s (soft), kv_cache_ttl 30s -> 60s for warmups. requesting SRE + ops watch.
Miles T: ack. please run deploy-bot dry-run and paste the diff here. I'll monitor p50/p95 and OOMs.
deploy-bot: dry-run complete for change set cset-789. No schema errors. Config diff: +"tenant_caps":{"tenant-42":{"concurrency":8,"weight":0.5}}, +"timeouts":{"request_ms":8000}, +"kv_cache":{"ttl_s":60}"
Amanda C: posting config snippet for visibility:
```json
{
  "tenants": {
    "tenant-42": {
      "concurrency": 8,
      "weight": 0.5,
      "notes": "temporary guardrail for late-afternoon surge"
    }
  },
  "defaults": {
    "timeouts": {"request_ms": 8000},
    "kv_cache": {"ttl_s": 60}
  }
}
```
Yuki N: quick question — do we need an opt-in flag for the tenant or is this global per-tenant override? If traffic is very bursty we might want a gradual ramp (weight 0.5 is fine). Also suggest a 10m grace metric window and alert if 5xx rate > 1%.
Miles T: agree on the metric window. I'll set a temporary alert and keep an eye on in-flight queue depth. If p99 latency increases > 200ms or OOMs spike, we'll roll back.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for 2022-10-17T17:00:00-07:00 (change set cset-789). Canary gating: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 6 minutes.
Amanda C: launching canary now :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary rollout 10% complete. No immediate errors reported.
ops-robot: health checks OK for canary hosts. CPU ~45%, memory stable, request success 99.7%. Observability link: https://console.redwood/obs/cset-789
Yuki N: seeing slight p95 uptick (~60ms) but p99 is stable. continuing to watch.
Miles T: heads-up — small bump in retry rate from this tenant, 0.8% -> 1.3%. Still under threshold but watching.
Amanda C: proceeding to 50%
deploy-bot: rollout 50% complete.
ops-robot: two 502s from tenant-42 on host inference-07 within last 2m. error traces: short lived, investigating.
Yuki N: those 502s correlate with a GC pause on inference-07. p99 latency spiked. recommendation: hold at 50% for 10m and evaluate OOM/Garbage patterns.
Amanda C: pausing rollout and flagging for potential rollback. Can we run a quick remap to route tenant-42 back to previous cap while we debug?
Miles T: I can trigger an immediate rollback if we continue to see repeated 502s or OOMs. Standby.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by Amanda C (cset-789 revert -> cset-788). Rolling changes back to previous config.
ops-robot: rollback complete. All hosts report healthy, 502s cleared.
Amanda C: thanks — rollback done. Created follow-up ticket RED-312 to investigate GC and to trial a softer timeout change (10s) + staged weight 0.6 next attempt.
Yuki N: noted. rebooked a quick sync for tomorrow to discuss guardrail strategy and tenant-specific warmups. :calendar:
Miles T: thanks everyone. TL;DR — config-only guardrail attempted, canary saw host-level GC-related errors, rollback executed cleanly. Next try will be more gradual and include host-level GC mitigation. :white_check_mark:
